earnings.title: Viatris Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Delivers Total Revenues of $3.75 Billion, U.S.
Returns Approximately $717 Million of Capital to Shareholders Year to Date, Including Through Share Repurchases
(3) Excluding the impact of transaction-related and restructuring-related costs of $81 million, free cash flow for the three months ended September 30, 2026, was $895 million.

quotes.text: Our third-quarter results reflect strong execution and reinforce our confidence in the growth trajectory of our business.
We are very pleased with the operational momentum across our higher-margin businesses and continued focus on cost discipline, which led to strong overall third-quarter results.
quotes.by: Paul Campbell, Interim CFO, Chief Accounting Officer & Corporate Controller, Viatris

outlook: The Company generated approximately $115 million in new product revenues (approximately $287 million for the year) and now expects to deliver approximately $450 million in new product revenues in full-year 2026.

The Company estimates the total revenue impact of supply constraints was approximately $100 million in the third quarter of 2026 and currently anticipates an impact of approximately $100 million to total revenues in the fourth quarter of 2026.

items.heading: The pharmaceutical industry is heavily regulated, and we face significant costs and uncertainties associated with our efforts to comply with applicable laws and regulations.

We have and may continue to experience pressure on the pricing of and reimbursements for certain of our products due to pricing controls, social or government pressure to lower the cost of drugs, and consolidation across the supply chain.

We may not realize the intended benefits of, or achieve the intended goals or outlooks with respect to, our strategic initiatives and priorities, including our enterprise-wide strategic review and other potential corporate transactions.

Viatris’ restructuring activities may not achieve their intended goals and may present significant challenges, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, ability to pay dividends or repurchase shares, and/or stock price.

There are risks and uncertainties associated with divestitures, product rationalizations and asset sales, one or more of which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, ability to pay dividends or repurchase shares, and/or stock price.

The integration of acquired businesses has presented and may in the future present significant challenges, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, ability to pay dividends or repurchase shares, and/or stock price.
